proposal.summary: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series (firmware ≤ 3.3-006) and BACnetstac ≤ 4.2.1 expose device management over FTP and Telnet which transmit sensitive information (e.g., credentials) in cleartext, allowing an attacker to obtain credentials and gain system access.
proposal.affected_product: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series firmware 3.3-006 and prior; BACnetstac version 4.2.1 and prior
proposal.cwe_quote: Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

AV.quote: Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

PR.quote: An attacker could obtain sensitive information such as user credentials to gain access to the system.

C.quote: Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Recommend vendor provide firmware and BACnetstac updates that add encrypted management protocols (e.g., SFTP/FTPS, SSH) or disable cleartext services; in the meantime, advise network mitigations (segment devices, restrict access, use VPN/management network) and rotate credentials after remediation.

evidence_quotes.claim: Management protocols are FTP and Telnet only
evidence_quotes.quote: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series with firmware version 3.3-006 and prior and BACnetstac version 4.2.1 and prior have only FTP and Telnet available for device management.
Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attacker can obtain credentials and gain access
evidence_quotes.quote: An attacker could obtain sensitive information such as user credentials to gain access to the system.
